WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
),
kept_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.avg_amount, oa.avg_amount AS overall_avg
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.avg_amount
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_amount,
    avg_amount - overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
    avg_amount - AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS above_kept_events_average
FROM kept_events
ORDER BY above_kept_events_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with a NULL event link are excluded because they cannot be attributed to an event.
